bulletGroups.heading: Outsourced as Platform Engineer at Thomson Reuters
bullets: Deployed indirect tax calculation microservices on Kubernetes clusters using Helm, enabling scalable, fault-tolerant, and highly available systems across environments via CI/CD pipelines, and architected a multi-layer observability stack for proactive alerting.
Automated workflows following GitOps practices using GitHub Actions for building custom Docker images, and built authentication for secure image access to Amazon ECR using AWS Cognito.

bulletGroups.heading: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) in Cloud Managed Services Team
bullets: Applied SRE practices including 24x7 on-call production support, incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and proactive reliability improvements, ensuring adherence to SLA/SLO targets and error budgets, improving system stability in a high-availability distributed environment.
Designed a monitoring solution leveraging New Relic for enhanced observability across 30+ accounts.
Automated alerting using CloudWatch, EventBridge, CloudTrail, Lambda, aligned with SLI/SLO and proactive incident management.
Built hybrid monitoring with Azure Monitor, ensuring high availability and supporting business continuity across multi-cloud environments.
Processed 10+ TB/day structured and unstructured data using AWS Glue and ETL pipelines for real-time analytics.
Built querying system using AWS Athena, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, reducing MTTR and improving debugging efficiency.

bulletGroups.heading: High-Availability CI/CD Pipeline in AWS
bullets: Implemented a resilient CI/CD pipeline using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and GitHub Actions, ensuring 99.95% uptime.

bulletGroups.heading: Scalable Logging and Monitoring with ELK Stack
bullets: Built centralized logging and monitoring system using ELK Stack and Docker, improving observability and debugging efficiency.
